dropbox.scope_limit: Root direct entries and selected relevant recursive hierarchies only; not every unrelated subtree or mount content

drive.scope_limit: Folder discovery is provider-token terminal. Individual file lists expose no continuation token. A below-cap list is not falsely labelled an explicit provider terminal token; one 1000-item parent list remains partial.

time_observation.earliest_reads_start_qualification: Not instrumented; no fabricated start timestamp

privacy: Nonpublic or unrelated identities are not published. Public names/IDs are limited to known public research scope; omitted items retain aggregate counts.
